items.name: Longsword
items.text: A plain, well-kept blade.

items.name: Shortsword
items.text: Short, quick and honest.

items.name: Rapier
items.text: A slender duelling blade with a basket hilt.

items.name: Dagger
items.text: Every pack should have one.

items.name: Mace
items.text: Flanged iron on an oak haft.

items.name: Quarterstaff
items.text: Ash wood, worn smooth by your hands.

items.name: Battleaxe
items.text: A bearded axe with a notched edge.

items.name: Greatsword
items.text: Too heavy for most. Not for you.

items.name: Shortbow
items.text: A recurved hunting bow.

items.name: Longbow
items.text: Yew, taller than you are.

items.name: Leather armour
items.text: Boiled leather, oiled against the rain.

items.name: Studded leather
items.text: Leather riveted with steel.

items.name: Scale mail
items.text: Overlapping steel scales on a leather coat.

items.name: Chain mail
items.text: Heavy rings of riveted steel.

items.name: Shield
items.text: Oak and iron, painted with a river heron.

items.name: Healing draught
items.text: Red, bitter, and it works.

items.name: Greater healing draught
items.text: It glows faintly in the dark.

items.name: Trail rations
items.text: Hard bread, harder cheese.

items.name: Thieves' tools
items.text: Picks and wires in a leather roll.

items.name: Spellbook
items.text: Your spells, in your own cramped hand.

items.name: Holy symbol
items.text: A sunburst of beaten bronze.

items.name: Lute
items.text: Scuffed, much loved, slightly out of tune.

items.name: Signet ring
items.text: Your family's seal. It opens fewer doors than it used to.

items.name: Lucky coin
items.text: Two heads, no tails.

items.name: Battered journal
items.text: Half your notes are questions.

items.name: Hunting trap
items.text: Iron jaws on a chain.

items.name: Torch
items.text: Pitch-soaked rag on a stick.

items.name: Hempen rope
items.text: Fifty feet of it.

items.name: Bunch of wildflowers
items.text: Meadowsweet and blue cornflower, tied with grass.

items.name: Bottle of fine wine
items.text: Red from the southern slopes.

items.name: Honey cakes
items.text: Still warm, wrapped in a cloth.

items.name: Silver locket
items.text: Empty, waiting for a portrait.

items.name: Book of old ballads
items.text: Love songs, mostly sad.

items.name: Fine whetstone
items.text: A dwarven stone, the kind smiths covet.

items.name: Wolf pelt
items.text: Grey and thick.

items.name: Blackbriar thorn
items.text: Cold to the touch, and it never warms.

items.name: River pearl
items.text: A freshwater pearl with a pink sheen.

items.name: Marsh lily
items.text: Pale, and it smells like rain.
